name: lightbox
title: Lightbox
description: Opens a full-screen viewer for images, with close, download and share buttons. One dialog on the page serves every image link.

attributes.name: data-lightbox
attributes.description: Must contain both the image links and the dialog.

attributes.name: data-lightbox-action="show:prevent"
attributes.description: Opens the viewer with the link's href instead of following it.

attributes.name: data-lightbox-url
attributes.description: URL used for download and share, e.g. a version served with Content-Disposition: attachment.

attributes.name: data-lightbox-target
attributes.description: dialog (the ), zoomedImage (the ), download (the ) and share (the web share button).

attributes.name: data-lightbox-action="close->reset"
attributes.description: Clears the image and links when the dialog closes.

actions.name: show
actions.description: Shows the dialog with the clicked link's image.

actions.name: reset
actions.description: Clears the image, the download link and the share file.

notes: The share button uses the web_share component and hides itself where the Web Share API is unavailable.
Press Escape to close the viewer.
